tei:div.tei:p: stakrosnarmo gebi zla ——/—rwabhukhyiphyo ce ṣṭha// lhurtsott+waṃ/sdom gsum rnam bsharda bīdzwa lam dzi gsal bha'i me long / kā khye dzā— kyi spra zhe hphasto4 dzotre)ri ci ri rme( — byuspyo— ——— tshodzi— bsod nams rgya mtshos ba mas kā khukiṣṭag mtsho sngon mi snyos dpe spun khang / ( — hūṃ rkorsā bee tekshisprekhukhu — — dngha—nga ko 3sto
༄7/ /sdom gsum rnam bshad thar lam gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bsod nams rgya mtshos brtsams/mtsho sngon mi riganu dpe spu na khang /

rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/mtsho sngon nang bstan slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan bsod nams rgya mtsho khong ni bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i me mo lug ste spyi lo/967lo'i zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu nyin mtsho lho'i rma rab 'og rab rgan sde ba nas pha klu sgrub dang ma rnam rgyal sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su bltams/ dgung lo drug gi steng nas bzung yab kyi mdun nas bod yig 'bri klog bslabs shing sde ba'i slo ba chung du zhugs/ dgung lo bcu gsum gyi steng don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs7rje btsun blo bzang rdo rje dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang thob cing khong gis thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung / dgung lo bcu drug gi steng tang gi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus kyi 'od stong 'dzin ma'i khyon la slar yang 'phros pa'i skabs dang bstun nas 'jartsa mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas mchog sku 'bum byams pa gling du rang mos kyis rab tu byung / yo ngas rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga'

bdag bla brang bkra 'is 3khyil gyi dase ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje btsun ye shes rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos mkhan po dang / bcu phrag gzhung lugs/ ma 'u sa pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mnga' brnyes shing yi dam rdo rje 'jisas byed kyi rnal 'byor ba/ rje sku 'bum byams pa gling gi dbe ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bla ma rin po che don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te7rje btsun blo bzang rdo rje dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dus go slob dpon mdzad de sku 'bum 'jam dbyangs sgar ba nas rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos shing mtshan la bsod nams rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ de nas bzung bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs7rje btsun blo bzang rdo rje dpal bzang po bas/ma sbyo ra gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas mgo bsdus grwa nas bzung mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa sbyang mgo brtsams/ lo der tshogs 'don cha tshang rgyan 'jug dang bcas pa sku 'bum bla ma tshogs 'dus la blo rgyugs sprad de dpyid chos dang po'i steng tshogs chos grwar zhugs te chos rtsod la hur thag byas/ dgung lo nyi shu'i steng 'dzin grwa ’ zhung gsar la thon nas mtsho sngo na nang bstan slo ba grwa chen mor rgyugs 'aṭwāṃd de 986lo'i zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin slob grwar

zhusas/ lo gsu ma gyio ring la sum rtasanu dag sasu myo/ sgra snyan ngag la ma rim blo sbyong phar phyin cha tshang bcas bsla bas /'or du rtsis sa ris sngags kyi sa lam sogs sbya ngas te slo ba ma/thar phyin/ de nas sla ra yang sku 'bum chos grwar song nas dbu ma myo/dzod 'dul ba sogs la sbyangs nas dgung lo nyer bdun steng sazhung bka' pod lnga la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa'i dam bca' ba'ag mdo sngags yongs su sbyangs pa de sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang lhan cig bgro gleng mdzad pas khong rnam pas bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor bar mdzad/ dgung lo nyer brgyad kyi steng / bal bor gtan sdod byed pa'i nye mi zhig gis gdan drangs pa ltar rang zhing nas lag khyer yi ge blangs te bal bo dang rgya gar gyi gnas chen rnams la zla bzhi'i ring gnas mjal legs par zin te slar yang sku 'bum la yong nas slob gnyer byas/ dgung lo so gnyis steng sku 'bum lnga rig skyed tshal gling gi dge thon byas te slob ma rnams la rig gnas dang bsdus grwa blo rtags thog mar blo sbyo nga sogs dpe khrid byas// dgung lo so drug ste bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu rta(spyi 'o 9’0 3)'o 'i zla dgu ba'i tshes gnyis nyin nas bzung slob gtso don la gas rdis

gdan 'dren zhunu pa ltar mtsho sngon nang bsta na slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gyi 'gan 'khur bzhin yod do/ /gzhan yang rab tu byung nas da bar du bsten pa'i bla ma ni/ yongs 'dzin du rje btsun chos kyi rgyal ma/tshan dpal bzang po dang/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag7lā mo rngo ngaṭa 'dzin rje bcun blo bzang mkhas grub rgya mtsho dpal bzang po sogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bcu phrag gcig lhag bsten te dbang lung man ngag sogs kyis thugs rgyud gtams so/ /chos mtshams kyi skabs su sngon 'gro sogs yi dam lha 'i bsnyen mtshams la brtson pa byas/ rgyal nang gi rgya rigs slo ba ma yu /sa sin kun dang tshun long sogs kyis gdan drangs pa ltar kre cang dang bun kro'u/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga hrang ha'e/ kung kro'u/ hrin krin sogs su lo snga phyir phebs te slob ma rnams la skyabs 'gro dang sher snying sogs kyi 'u nga gnang zhing dkar nag las 'bras sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyi chos sbyin gnang ngo //bris bye/sa/ byu lo2༷༷ /lori za1༷pa ri ches 8nyin āob ma ches rab rgya rme tshos ‘

dkar chagamachod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/ (/)skabs dang po/ so thar gyi sdom pa bstang pa / (da)sdom pa ma thob pa 'thob par byed pa'i thabs/ (9)sdom pa thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i thabs (/2)nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs/ ( 3)bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bshad pa/ (/ )dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bshad pa/ (—//)rab byung gi sdom pa bshad pa/ ( 27)dge tshul gyi sdom pa bshad pa/ (3 3)bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bshad pa/ (3 )ltung ba pham pa'i sde/ (36)lhung ba lhag ma'i sde/ ( 2)ltung byed kyi sde/ (dwa )ltung ba sor bshags kyi sde/ ( 7)

lhung ba nyes byas kyi sde/ ( ribasla ba pa ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs/ ( /)bslab pa bsrungs pa'i phan yon/ ( /3)skabs gnyis pa/ byang sems kyi sdom pa bgad pa ( 3 8)byang sems kyi rtsa ltung / ( 6 )byang sems kyi nyes byas/ ( 75)byang sdom bsrungs pa'i phan yon/ (200)skabs gsum pa/ sngags kyi sdom pa bshad pa/ ( 207)rgyal ba rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bshad pa/ ( 2 ( ’)rigs lnga spyi yi dam tshig las sngags kyi rtsa ltung gi skor/ ( 2 3)sngags kyi yan lag gi dam tshig (2 29)sngags kyi dam tshig bsrungs pa'i phan yon/ ( 237)

mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄7ོ/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rab dkar tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs shing / /rab mdzes mtshan bzang dpal gyis brgyan/ /rab snyan gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan/ /rab bzang shākya'i gtso la 'dud/ /de sras thu bo byams pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /rdor sems rigs sras tshul sprul sgra gcan 'dzin/ /zab rgyas lam bzang legs par ston mdzad pa'i/ /klu sgrub thogs med 'bas la gus pas 'dud/ /mdo rgyud man ngag kun la mkhas/ /bslab gsum rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes/ /rgya bod bstan pa'i dpung gnyen mchog /

jo bo a ti sha la 'dud/ /dmu rgod 'dul dka' bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /'tshe med zhi bde khrims kyi srol bzang po/ /kun du spel la 'gran pa'i zla bral ba/ /bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum phyagage yul/ /shes bya kun la mkhyen pas dbang bsgyur zhing / /'chad pas ris med gdul bya grol bar mdzad/ /rtsod pas nang pa'i dbu 'phang dgung la bstad/ /sa skya paṇa chen 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /sdom gsu ma rnam par dag pa'i khrims kyis mdzes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa phyogs bcur spel / /'jam dbyangs mi yi rnam rol tsong kha pa/ /bdag snying padmor bzhugs la byin gyis rlobs/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa mchog /yanganu/ pa'i rgyal khams mtha' dag la/ /lham mer spel ba'i sras mchog gnyis/ /kun gyis mchod bkur me tog gtor/ /

lung rtogs bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan che/ /srid rtse bar du bsgrengs mkhanu pa/ /rgya bod mkhas grub rim byon rnams/ /bdag gis gtsug tu bkod de mchod/ /dri med lung dang rigs pa yinu / /bshad sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dge ldan snyan brgyud phyogs bcur spel / /rje btsun bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /blo gros bzang pos shes bya mtha' dag gzigs/ /'gyur med brtan po'i rdo rje'i sku mchog brnyes/ /bstan 'gro'i don chen 'bad med lhun gyis grub/ /rje bcun bla mas tshe rabs kun du skyongs/ / 'jam 'jam ye shes 'bar ba'i 'od snang gis/ /legs legs gzhung lugs rgya mcho1re don rnams gzigs/ / snyan snyan kun nas mdzes pa'i gsu/nga rab rnamyo nu / /mang mang 'gro la spel mkhas khyed la 'dud/ /3

slob gling padma'i dga' tshal 'dir/ /thar ba don gnyer slob ma tshor/ /sdormā gsum gsal ba'i me long zhig /bdag gis dga' gus sems kyis 'bul/ /de yang gochod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca'ame tog gi phreri bas mdun bsus te sdom gsum rnam bshadalam gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba brjod par bya'o/ /sdom gsu/ma gyi rnam gzhag bshad pa la dang po so thar sdom pa bshad pa dang / gnyis pa byang sems kyi sdom pa ba pa dang / gsu/ma pa sngags kyi sdom pa bshad pa'o/ /

skabs dang po/ so thar gyi sdom pa bshad pa/de yang ji skad du dpal mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo dang sngags kyi yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba/ dkar chos kun gyi gzhi ma/ mtho ris dang thar ba'i them skas/ 'di phyi'i bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/mchog thun dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba/ yi dam gyi lha 'grub pa'i thabs mchog chos skyong thams cad 'khor ba'i dam rdzas/ skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i dmiganu/ rkyen/ gnod pa thams cad las skyob pa'i srung ma/ lam gyi gegs sel bogs 'don gyi thabs mchog mchog dman su yis mthong yang mi mthun pa med pa'i mdzes rgyan/ 'dzam gling zhi bde yi khrims bzang /thar 'dod kun gyi 'jug ngogs/ bde skyid kyi zhing khams bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi/ yid la gang bas/ma 'grub pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu ni/ gang khas blangs/ pa'i bslab sdom 5

tshul bzhin du bsrung ba 'di yin par mdo sngags bstan bcos thams cad las/ lan re re ma yin par gsu/nga nan drag pos yang yang gsungs pa de'i phyir 'dir nye bar mkho ba so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa gsum gyi rnam ga'ag bsdus pa zhig brgyud ldan bla ma'i bzhed srol ji bzhin du bshad par bya'o/ /'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i gsu/nga rtsom dge tshul slong gi gnam rtsed ldeng ma gnyis dang / snga gas dang byang sems kyi rtsa ltung rnam bshad chen mo sogs las sdom gsum gyi skor 'di shin tu gsal bor gsungs yod na yang / rang nyid chos tshul 'di la legs par goms pa'i phyir dang mtsho sngon nang bsta na slob gling gi bla sprul ched sbyong 'dzin grwar gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i gsung tshe gcig nyams len gyi dpe thog nas sdom gsum rgyas par dpe khrid bshad skabs 'dul gzhung mang po zhig la zhib tu bltas te mi brjed pa'i thor sdom gsum gyi tshig 'grel go bde ba zhig bris pa 'di'i gong 'og kun tu nor ba'i cha mchis tshe chos 'dul ba'i mdzod la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo la bdag gis snying nas 'gyod pas 6

bshags so/ /de yang gong du bshad pa ltar/ mdo sngags thams cad kyi lam gyi rtsa ba sdom pa gsum la thug cing / sdom pa phyi ma gnyis kyi rtsa ba yang so thar gyi sdom pa la thug par mdo las gsungs par ma zad/ sngags nas kyang so thar gyi sdom pa gal che bar lan grangs mang por gsungs pa 'di ltar/ tshul khrims yang dag par bstan pa'i mdo las kyang /tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan/ /tshul khrims ldan pa grags 'gyur bde ba 'thob/ /tshul khrims ldan pa mtho ris 'gro ba'i rgyu/ /tshul khrims bsrungs pas mya ngan 'das thob 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud las kyang /ji ltar lo tog thams cad sa la ni/ /brten nas skyon med par ni skyes pa ltar/ /de bzhin tshul khrims brten nas chos dkar mchog /snying rje'i chus brlan pas ni rnam par skye/ /rgyal ba ngas gsungs so sor thar ba yi/ /tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba ma lus pa/ /7

sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cho ga spangs/ /lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bcas rkyang gi bslab pa re gnyis ma gtogs thams cad la sngags pa khyim pas kyang bslab dgos na/sngags la zhugs pa'i rab byung ba rnams kyis slob dgos pa lta ci smos/ de ltar na sngags nas kyang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa/dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa/ khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa gsum gyi nang nas dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog tu bsngags te/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las kyang /lha khang sogs kyi rab gnas sogs/ /rtags can gyis ni rtag tu bya/ /gnas gcig tu ni gsum gnas na/ /khyim pa gos dkar ldan pas min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/8

sngomasnyepa ma thob pa 'thob par byed pa'i thabs/spyir sdom pa la sdom pa ma thob pa 'thob par byed pa'i thabs/ thob pa mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs gsum yod pa las/dang po la/ sngon chog dang / da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs tshul lo/ /sngon chog la bcu rngo da de/dang po ni/ de bzhin bshegs pa rang byung gis bsnyen par rdzogs/gnyis pa ni/ ko'u di n+yas sogs lnga sde ye shes khong du chud pas bsnyen par rdzogs/gsu ma pa ni/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs chen pos ston pa khas blangs pa'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs/bzhi ba ni/ legs sbyin la ston pas gcig tu dgos pa'i chos de gang yin zhes dris pas thar ba'o/ /zhes lan bteb/de la dargas pa gang yin zhes pas/ dad pa'o/ /zhes lan 9

thebs pas ston pa mnyes pa tsam gyis bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /lnga ba ni/ grags pa dang mchog zung gnyis la sogs pa ston pa'i 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor srid pa tha ma ba phal cher zhig la ston pas/ dge slong / tshur shog tshangs par spyod cig ces pas tshur shog gis bsnyen par rdzogs/drug pa ni/ sde bzang drug cu la ston pas skyabs 'gro lan gsum bzlas pa tsam gyis bsnyen par rdzogs/bdun pa ni/ skye dgu'i bdag mo sogs bud med lnga brgya la lci ba'i chos brgyad khas blangs pas bsnyen par rdzogs/brgyad pa ni/ ston pas dge slong ma utpal la 'phrin par btang ste chos sbyin ma khyim na gnas bzhin du dge bsnyen dang dge tshul dge slong dang bsnyen rdzogs rnams rim gyis bsgrubs so /dgu ba ni/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa lnga tshogs kyis mtha' 'khob kyi mi rnams bsnyen par rdzogs/bcu ba ni/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa bcu tshogs kyis yul dbus kyi mi rnams bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /sngon chog bcu bo 'di dag 0

gis bsnyen par rdzogs tshul ston pa dngos su 'al bzhugs pa'i dus su byung zhing 'phrin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa 'di ma gtogs thams cad la dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa rnams gcig car du thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon chog gis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong so so skye bo sems ma btul ba dang ngag kyal ma bsdams pa skor zhig la mkhan slob med pas sde snod gsum la legs par ma sbyangs pa dang / sgra mthon po dang / sgra chen po dang / rbod bag gi spyod lam gyis grong dang grong khyer du rgyu bas mu stegs pa rnams kyis kha gtong ba dang 'phya smod byed/ ga'an yang nad g.yo ga med pas dge slong zhig kyang shi ba'i rkyen gyis/ ston pas nyan thos rnams kyis gcig gis gcig bsdu ba dang / nad pa rnams la nad g.yog rim gro bya ba'i phyir dang / kun la 'tshe ba med pa'i bstan pa rin po che rgya cher 'phel zhing yu na ring du gnas pa la sogs pa'i 'phral phugs kyi phan bde du ma zhig la dgongs te da chog nyes med phun tshogs kyi bsnyen par rdzogs tshul 'di gsu/ngas/ brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan

pa'i dge slong zhig la mkhan por gsol/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa 'dul ba'i las la mkhas shing phan thogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i gsang ston slob dpon/ las slob/ kha skong dge slong / dus go ba sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su/ dge bsnyen dang / rab byung / dge tshul dang dge slo nga rnams rim gyis mngon gyur bcu'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa ni da chog gi bsnyen par rdzogs tshul lo/ /mngon gyur bcu ni/ ston pa mngon du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas mngon du gyur pa/ chos mngon du gyur pa/ mkhan po mngon du gyur pa/ slob dpon mngon du gyur pa/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i 'dod pa mngon du gyur pa/ yo byad mngon du gyur pa/ yongs su dag pa mngon du gyur pa/ gsol ba mngon du gyur pa/ las mngon du gyur pa'o/ /sngom pa thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i thabs/sdom pa thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i thabs ni/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnanu/sa dang 'grogs shing / ji 2

srid 'tsho yi bar du sdom pa srung snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan po'i ngang nas ltung ba dang ltang ba ma yin pa rnams ngo shes par byas te/ dran shes gnyis tshul bzhin du bsten te bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i sgo nas bsrungs pa dang / ga'an yang mtha' gnyis su mi lhung ba'i gnas khang dang mal stan/ zas gos dang sman bzhi sogs bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen brten pa'i sgo nas srung ba ni sdom pa thob pa mi nyams par srung ba'i thabs so /nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs/nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs/ ni/ pham pa 'chab bcas byung na sdom pa slar mi skye bas dge 'dun gyis gnas dbyung bya dgos/ pham pa 'chab med byung ba la mkhan slob sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su sla ra yang bsnyen rdzogs bskyar sgrub byas na sdom pa skye na yang dgra bcom thob bar du tshe 'dir dge 'dun gyi gral mthar 'grim dgos/ ltung ba lhag ma man chad kyi ltung ba byung na bshags 'onu/ pa rnams bshags/ bsdam 'os pa'i ltung ba rnams bsdams/ byin gyis brlab 'os pa'i 3

ltung ba rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ gso sbyong gi dus su phyir bcos byas na ltung ba'i nyes pa rnams nges par 'dag par gsungs so/ /stobs bzhi sdig dag ltung ba dag pa med/ /ces pa'i lung 'di'i shugs bstan gyis kyang shes/ 'dul ba rgya mcho'i snying bo las/bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen pha ma dang / /dge tshul pha ma dge slob ma/ /dge slong ma dang dge slong ste/ /so sor thar ba rigs brgyad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar so thar rigs brgyad yod/bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa bshadapa/bsnyen gnas ni/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo las/rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag bzhi/ /brgyad spong bsnyen gnas sdom pa'o/ /zhes gsu ngas pa ltar/ spang bya brgyad khyim pa rnams kyis nyin zhag gcig la spong ba'i mtha' can no/ /mi tshangs spyod dang 4

ma byin par len pa dang srog gcod pa dang rdzun du smra ba bzhi ni rtsa ba bzhi yin la/ chang 'thung ba dang / gar sogs/ phreng sogs/ khri gdan che mtho dang bzhi ni yan lag bzhi yin pas nyin zhag gcig la 'di dag spang dgos so/ / cibasnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa 'bog chog ni/ston pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyis pa/ deng 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du long gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su/ mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral skarnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su/ mchi'o/ /bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ bsnyen gnas yan lag rgyad par ston pas gzung du gsol/ /'di la na gsum brjod mas/ gsum pa'i skabs kyi bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad par bya pa'i tshig de rdzogs pa dang mnyam du bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa thob snyam pa'i bsam pa 'jog de nas ston pas gzung du gsol byasarjes sku 'dras thabs yin no gsu/nga bar mos te/ rang gis logs so/ zhes lan 'debs byed/ mjug gi cho ga ni/ phyag 5

gsu/ma 'tshal nas/ spang bya brgyad po spang snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ ston pa dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /yan lag dang po 'di bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom rnams kyi bslab pa la rjes su bslab bo/ /rjes su/ bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang /mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas dang / glu gar dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / phreng ba dang / spos shug pa dang /rgyan dang kha dog 'ching ba dang /khri gdan mthon po dang chen po dang / dus ma yin pa'i kha zas spangs te/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sang nyi ma rnga/ 6

shar gyi bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / rdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / spos shug pa dang / rgyan dang kha dog 'ching ba dang / khri gdan mthon po dang chen po dang / dus min gyi kha zas spangs te dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las slar log par bgyi'o/ /yan lag brgyad po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom rnams kyi bslab pa la rjes su bslab bo/ /rjes su/ bsgrub bo/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /zhes rjes zlos lan gcig bya/ mjug tu thabs legs brjod do/ /'di ni rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po'i gsu/nga bzhin bkod pa'o/ /'di'i pha ma ni/ pho mo'i ming yin la / bod na dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis yod/ dge tshul ma dang / dge slob ma dang / dge slo nga ma gsum gyi sdom pa ni logs su bshad 'dod pas 'dir mi 'god/ dge bsnyen sogs bshad pa la/ so thar gyi sdom pa gang yin kyang thog mar len pa'i kun slo nga ni/ byang chub la ma rim che chung sogs nas bshad pa ltar/ mgo bshes gnyen bsten tshul/ de nas skyabs 'gro/ skyes bu chung ngu'i ska bas su/ skyabs 'gro'i rgyu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la skra ga pa dang / skra ga nas de la sa 7

skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog la yod pa'i yid ches pa gnyis yin la/ de ltar rgyu gnyis sngon du btang nas mchog gsum la kha tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas sdug bsngal de dag las skyob pa'i skyabs 'tshol ba'i blo ni/ skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo yin la/sdom pa len pa'i skabs 'dir 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gnyis ka'i sdug bsngal la skrag nas thar ba yan chad thob pa'i ched du dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyes bu 'bring yan chad kyi skyabs 'gro dgos so/ /de ltar na bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin du bsten te dkon mchog la skyabs su song nas/ chos la bskul ba'i ched du dal 'byor 'di'i steng nas sangs rgyas man chad sgrub chog pas/ dal 'byor don che tshul dang / phyin chad dal 'byor 'di rgyu 'bras gang gi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul sogs bsams nas nges shes 'drong bar byed pa dang / de nas blo sbyong tshul ni/nges par 'chi ba/ nam 'chi nges med/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan pa ste rtsa ba gsum dang / de re re la rgyu mtshan gsum re ste rgyu mtshan dgu dang / rgyu mtshan gsu/ma 8

re'imajug tu chos bya dgos par thag bcad gsum sogs kyi sgo nas blo sbyong ba dang / de nas da lta rang re'i rgyud na mi dge ba bcu sogs yod tshul/ mi dge ba de dag gi 'bras bus ngan sgong gsum du skye tshul sogs las 'bras sems pa dang / ngan hong du snyes na dmyal ba na tsha grang / btso sreg yi dwags na ba skyob skom/ dud 'gro na bkol spyod rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal sogs yod tshul bsams te/ de las skyob pa'i phyir du yang yang dkon mchog la snying nas skyabs 'gro byed pa dang / ngan song chu sdug bsngal ngo da par ma zad/ bde 'gro na yang mi la skye rba na 'chi/ lha ma yin la phrag dog 'thab rtsod/ lha la yang 'thab rtsod dang / 'chi 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal/ lha gong ma dag la yang tshe zad pa na/ 'khor ba la zhen chags ma spangs pa'i dbang gis ngan song du skyes te slar sdug bsngal myong dgos pa sogs/ mdor na srid rtse nas mnar med bar gyi bde ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin tshul la nges shes 'drongs pa na/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i zhal nas/de ltar goms pas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la/ /9

yid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing / /nyin mtshan kun tu thar ba don gnyer blo/ /byung na de tshe nges 'byung skye ba lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi'i 'khor ba'i phun tshogs 'asgyur gyi rgyal srid dang / lha'i 'khor ba'i phun tshogs 'dodalnga dang / srid rtse'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba la yang sdug ngagyi rang bzhin du shes pa'i sgo nas/ 'di dang phyi ma gang du ngayid smon skad cig tsam yang mi skye zhing / nyin mtshan ku'akhor ba thams cad las thar zhing / nyon mongs thamasalas grol ba'i thar ba'i go 'phang zhig myur du thob par bya'opa'i blo bcos mi dgos par ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes pa nges 'byung gi bsam pa skyes pa yin zhing bsam pa de ma ma bcos ma yan chad kyis kun nas bslangs te so thar gyi sdocalen dgos pa yin no// de la bsnyen gnas dang / dge bgyi sdom pa khyim pa'i phyogs kyi sdom pa yin zhing / dge tshul chad kyi sdom pa ni/ rab byung gi sdom pa yin/ dge tshul bsgru/la thog mar rab byung sgrub da gos shing / rab byung du sgrub ’20

de'i thog mar dge bsnyen du bsgrub dgos so/ /dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bshad pa/dge bsnyen gyi bslab gzhi ni/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying bo las/gsod rku smra dang log par g.yem/ /myos 'gyur 'thung ba lnga spangs pa/ /dge bsnyen gyi ni sdom pa'o/ /'es gsungs pa ltar/ mi'am mir chags gso/da pa/ rdzas rin thang tshang ba rku ba/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba/ 'o ga g.yem dang bzhi'i steng du chang 'thung ba dang lnga yin la / gzhan gsum dge tshul sogs dang 'dra bas 'og tu 'chad la/ log g.yem ni/'dir rang gis bdag tu bzung ba'i bud med yod na de dang /med na smad 'tshong ma la rim/ gyis nyos pa ma gtoganu bud med gang la spyad kyang log g.yem du 'gyur la/ rang gi bud med yin kyang dus ma yin pa dang / gnas ma yin pa so/gas/ su/ spyad na/ log g.yem du 'gyur tshul lam rim sogs/ la bltas nas 2/

shes par bya'o/ /'di dag khyim pa'i dbang du btang la/ rab byung ba'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa'i skabs su bud med gang la'ang spyad du mi rung ngo / /spyir skyes pa bud med gang gi bgrod bya'i gnas ma yin pa dang /lus kyi cha shas sogs la 'khrig pa'i chos spyad na log g.yem du 'gyur tshul lam rim na gsal lo//bsnyen gnas dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gang las len pa'i yul ni sdom pa sbyin pa la mkhas pa'i dge bsnyen sdom ldan gyis kyang chog par gsungs so/ / ma sem/sa can gyi phan bde kho nar bsams pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis da lta 'dzam bu gling 'dir gnas pa'i 'gro ba mi yi rigs la 'tshe med zhi bde yi rtsa ba bsnyen gnas dang dge bsten gyi sdom pa 'di gnyis ma bskul dang blang gis spel bar kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs so/ /skyabs 'gro'i bsla ba bya rnams/ la'ang slo ba dgos pas/sangs rgyas la skyabs su/ so nga bas/ 'jig rten pa'i lha gzhan la gtan gyi skyabs mi 'tshol / chos la skyabs su so nga bas sems can la gnod 'tshe spong / dge 'dun la skyabs su/ song bas 22

grogs mu stegs can dang / dkon mchog dang la sa 'bras la mi dad cing yid mi ches pa rnams dang / mi dge ba la dga' ba'i nag phyogs pa rnams dang mi 'grogs pa dang mja' bo mi bya ba 2gag pa'i bslab bya dang / nyin mtshan kun tu skyabs 'gro rgyun du bya ba dang / dkon mchog la ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bzang pon ci 'dra zhig la yang sangs rgyas dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes 'jog pa dang / gsung rab kyi yi ge sna gcig yan chad chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes 'jog pa dang / sku gezugs dang / gsu nga rab 'o brgyal sar me 'jog pa dang /gta' mar mi 'jog pa dang / dge 'dun gyi na bza'i lhan pa sir po yan chad la dge 'dum/ dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes 'jog pa dang / mi 'gom pa dang gtsang sar skyel ba sogs la slob dgos pa yin/ thun mong gi bslab bya skyes bu dam pa la bsten pa/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ tshul bzhin yid la bya ba/chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i chos bsgrub pa/ dbang bo mi rgod pa dang / sdom pa ci nus su len pa dang / sems can la snying brtse ba 23

sogs lam rim chen mo las gsu ngari pa'i bsla ba bya nyi shu sogs la slob dgos pa'o/ /skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya nyi shu ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ chos kyi don bsam pa/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa/ dbang bo mi rgod par bya ba/bslab pa'i gzhi yang dag par blang ba/ snying brtse bas gzhan dag skyabs 'gro la 'god pa/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa la brtson pa/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas 'jig rten pa'i lha gzhan la skyabs su mi 'gro ba/ chos la skyabs su song bas sems can la gnod 'tshe spo nga ba/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas grogs log lta can sogs la mi 'grogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs legs nyes ci 'dra yin yang sangs rgyas dkon mchog ltar bkur ba/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dang khyad par sogs shes nas skyabs su 'gro ba/ ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod pa/ ga'an dag skyabs 'gro la 'god pa/ bya ba dang dkaus pa ci yod dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa/phan yon shes nas nyin la na gsu ma dang mtshan lan gsum du skyabs su 'gro ba/srog gi phyir yang skyabs 'gro mi gtong ba'o//3tsho

rab byung sogs su sgrub pa 'i mkhan po ni gang byung byung giru mi chogapas brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa yin/ brtan pa'i yon tan ni bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'asnyen rdzogs rnam dag gi sdom rgyun bar ma chad du lo bcu lon pas 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams ma lus pa rang gis sru/nga ba la brtan pa thob pa dang / mkhas pa'i yon tan ni lnga phrugs su sbyar ba nyer gcig gang rung la mkhas pa zhig dgos nga/sa/mdor na 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang gzhan la 'chad pa la mkhas shing rang gi slo ba myo/ chul bzhin du skyong ba la mkhas pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /lnga phrugs su sbyar ba nyer gcig ni 'dir mang du dogs pas 'dul ba'i gzhung chen mo rnams las shes pa ra bya'o/ /khyad par rab byung sogs su sgrub pa'i 'dul ba'i la sa chog mthong ba rgyud pa'i phyag len sogs la mi mkhas par rab byung sogs snang ba gang dran gyis smyon pa'i co co byas na bsgrub bya'i yu la la sdom khrim sa sogs mi skye bas / phan ma/ thobs pa'i steng du gnong pa de bas che ba med de/ slo ba ma de la sdom pa ma skye sa na dge

'dun gyi gral du bsdad na rku thabs su gnas pa yin zhing /phyin chad slob ma de'i sdom rgyun chad de mkhan slo ba gnyis kas chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa bshig pa yin pas stabs gzab pa shin tu gal che bas/ nor ba de 'dra mi byed par deng sang gi bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam 'di la yang phan ci thogs 'bad par bya zhes kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs so lags/ de ltar rab byung du sgrub pa la bar chad dang ldan mi ldan las chog ltar 'dri dgos shing / bar chad la'ang sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad/ gnas pa'i bar chad/ khyad par du 'gyur ba'i bar chad/ mdzes pa'i bar chad bzhi yo da pas/ skye ba'i bar chad dang ldan na sdom pa skyes kyang mkhan slob sogs la nyes pa 'ong bas/ bar chad rnams ngos zin pa gal che'o/ /'on kyang 'di ltar bshad pa 'dul ba'i bstan pa dngos la phan thogs pa'i dbang du btang la/ dgag bya yangs pa'i dbang du byas na/ de thams cad la bar ma'i tshul khrims nges par skye bas ga'an nyes spyod las ldog pa sogs dgos pa phra mo yo da par mngon no//tre/sgo)

rab byung gi sdom pa bshad pa/de ltar bar ma rab byung du bsgrubs nas bar ma rab byung gibasrung bya ni/ dge bsnyen gyi bsla ba gzhi lnga char gtogs dang paras pa skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang bcas pa'i steng du nyams sge rnam gsum spang dgos pa yin no//nyams pa rnam gsum ni/lhag na por gsol ba btab pa la sa nyams pa/ khyim pa'i rtags nga ba las nyams pa/ rab byung gi rtags len pa la nu nyam/sa gas3mas yin no//chorṇa nyams pa dang po ni/ mkhan por gsol ba btab pa'i slab bya/ slob ma des mkhan po la pha'i 'du thes ba'ag ste/ring gi ji snyed kyi yo byad rnams 'bul ba/ bsten bkur te g.yog ci dgos sgrub pa/ bya ba thams cad de la zhu dgos pa/ sgrub na rang ga'an la nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i bka' gang phebs sgrub pa sogs mkhan por gsol ba btab pa'i bsla ba bya thamyo/sa bud ma bsgru bas na nyams/ pa dang po 'byung ba yi na no/ /ma/khan pos kyang zhi rgyas dbang dras gi sgo nas slo ba ma de chos la 'jud — rka

pa dang / mo byad ci dargas stsol ba sogs slob ma de pha mas skyong ba ltar byed dgos shing / tha na slob ma na nas nad g.yog byed pa yan chad kyi don du ci 'gyur bya dgos so/ /nyams pa gnyis pa ni/ ston pas gnang ba'i rab byung gi na bza'/ gzan sham sogs btsun chas rgyun du ma byas na/ rab byung gi rtags len par khas blangs pa las nyams pa yin no/ /nyams pa gsum pa ni/ khyim pa'i gos spu gu zhes wa rtsag dang gos dkar po mtho gang yan chad ma g.yogs par gyon pa dang / zhwa rigs mi gcig pa dang / me cha khra bo gri ring bo mda' mdung sogs mtshon cha 'chang ba dang / skra dang kha spu sor do yan chad 'jog pa'o/ /de yang sngon yin na rab byung dang dge tshul slong gsar bu rnams kyis mkhan po'am gnas kyi bla ma zhig rgyun du bsten te/ des ci gsungs sgrub pa yin zhing /deng sang gnas kyi bla ma bsten pa phar zhog mkhan slob gnyis ka yang slob mas gar yod mi shes pas mkhan por gsol ba btab pa las nyams pa yin pas/ grwa chas mi gyon par khyim pa'i rtags bcings pa 'di tsho la nyams pa rnam gsum po byung yod la /28

de ltar na/ de las gzhan pa'i bar ma rab byung gi thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung bya gang yang med pas/ rab byung gi tshul khrims shor ba yin la/ rgyun du grwa chas byas na rab byung gi tshul khrims yod pa yin zhing / sangs rgyas dang mkhan po'i bka' brtsis shing / dad zas 'ju ba dang / lha dang mi dkar phyogs pa rnams dga' zhing bkra shis brjod pas/ rang gi bsam don 'grub pa dang / bstan pa dang / gzhan dad pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gro ba dang / grwa chas kyi rgyu chos phyogs su song ba dang /rang gi sbyin bdag la bsod nams chen po 'byung ba sogs phan mon mtha' yas shing / khyim pa'i rtags bcinganu na/ de la sa smog pa'i nyes dmigs yod pas/ ci la thug kyang grwa chas byed pacigal che zhes kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs so//dge tshul gyi sdom pa bshad pa/dge chul gyi bslab bya'i gtso bo ni/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying sgo las/rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag drug /2 9

bcu spong dge tshul sdom pa'o/ /gar sogs phreng sogs rnam gnyis dang / /gser dngul len dang rnam pa gsum/ /phye bas yan lag drug tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mi ma yin dang / mi dang / dud 'gro sogs shi gson gang rung gi ro phyed longs pa tshun chad kyi ba dang / bshang lam/ mo'i zag byed gsum po la'ang 'khrig pa'i chos spya da na mi changs spyod byung ba yin zhing / gzhan gsu ma dge bsnyen gyi skabs ltar ga'an gyi rdzas rin thang tshang ba rku thabs dang / gango sgyu so gas kyis bdag gir byed pa dang / mi dang mir chags gsod pa dang / mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba ste rtsa ba bzhi dang / chang 'thung ba dang / mal stan che mtho dang /gar dang / glu len pa sogs dang / lus la phreng ba dang rgyan sprudogs pa dang / phyi dro'i kha zas za ba dang / gser dngul sogs bdag gir byed pa ste bcu dang / de dag las gyes pa blang 'das so drug sogs/ yo da la / ma/dor na dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya dang nga gsu/ma/ gyi nang nas/ phyed dang bco brgyad ma 30

natogs thams cad bsrung dgos pa'i chul rje rin po ches nasungs pa'i dge tshul gyi bslab bya gnam rtsed ldeng ma sogs la bltas nas shes par bya'o/ /bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa babang pa da lta da chog gi dus yin pas/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa la/dge tshul yan chad bsgrub pa sngon du 'gro dgos shing bsnyen rdzogs kyi skabs 'dir yang / slo ba myo/'i 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gi sdu ga bsnga la dang / nyes dmigs banu ma pa dang / thar be'i phan yo na dran te/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba so gas gel che bas/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ gang gi bsnyen par rdzogs bo'i yul mkhan slob dang / dge 'dun ni yul dbus su ma hod na bcu dang / mtha' 'khob tu ma rnyed na lnga drug yan chad zongs tshang dgos shing / mkhan po yang gong du bshad pa ltar brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa nges par dgos /pa༄ slob/ gas nga ston slob dpon/ dus go'i slo ba dpon/ kha skokho slob dpon dang bcas pa kha sko nga gi chos bcu gsu/ma/ dang 3/

ldan pa dgos so / kha skong gi chos bcu gsum ni/'greng yu la 'dun sogs phur ba min/ /ma rdzogs nyams dang mchams med min/ /sdig lta tha dad 'khrul bcanu min/ /mtshams mtshan dkon mchog sa gzhan min/ /kha skong chos ni bcu sa/sum mo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ 'di dag gi rnam gzhag kyang 'dir mang du dogs pas ga'an du shes par bya'o/ /khyad par du slob ma rnams la mkhan slo ba dge 'dun dang bcas pa la dag pa'i 'du shes med na sdom pa mi skye/ phyag len dang cho ga'i gtso bo nor na'ang sdom pa mi skye bas/ gong du bshad pa ltar nges par stabs gzab dgos so/ /las slob nursā pa zur du med na mkhan slo ba sbrags ma byed pa'i phyag len yod kyang dge 'dun grangs tshang dgos so/ /mkhan slo ba kyis las chog dpe ngor 'don mi rung zhing / tshig phyed kyang ma 'khrul bar blo la thon pa nges par dgos/ 'dul ba lung dang / yig cha mang po nas na 2

la na myo nga ngo ra gsu ngas la / khungs/ bcun gyi phyag le na kyang 'di ltar byed do/ /'di yi skor stabs ma gzab na/ sdom rgyun chad pa dang /bstan pa bshig pa so gas sngar bshad pa ltar gyi nyes dmigs yod pas shin tu gal che'o/ /gzhan yang slob ma'i ngos nas 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum la sogs pa g.yar ba tshun chad dang mngon gyur bcu yang tshang dgos/ dge slong gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum ni/ snam sbyar/ bla gos/ mthang gos/ sham thabs/sham thabs kyi gzan/ jul gzan/ rngul gzan gyi gzan/gdong phyis/ rnag gzan/ g.yan pa gab pa/ spa bzed/gding ba/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen dang bcu gsu/ma mo/ /dus gowās sdom pa thob pa'i dus brjod pa la dus tshigs lnga yang shes dgos pas dus tshigs lnga ni dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar dang dbyar thung ngu dang dbyar ring po'o/ /dgun ni zla ba bcu ba'i tshes bcu drug nas zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar ro/ /dpyid ni zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nas zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar ro/ /dbyar ni zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu drug 33

nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga'i bar ro/ /dbyar thung ngu ni zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu drug gcig go /dbyar ring po ni zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas zla ba bcu ba'i tshes bco lnga'i bar ro/ /dang po la/ zla ba gnyis dang / gnyis pa la zla ba bzhi/ gsu ma pa la zla ba gcig bzhi ba ni tshes gcig go / lnga ba ni nyin zhag gcig gis ma chog pas zla ba gsum yod/ zla ba dang po nas bzung ste bcu gnyis pa'i bar rim pa bzhin du mchu zla/ dbo zla/ nag zla/ sa ga zla/ snron zla/ chu stod zla/ gro zhun zla/ khrums stod zla/ dbyig zla/ smin drug zla/ cha/so zla/rgyal zla 'es bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ /lyad par 'gal rkyen nges pa lnga dang bral dgos pas/ 'gal rkyen lnga ni/sems can 'di la spong la gzhan la mi spong snyam pa sems can nges pa/ yul 'dir spong la gzhan du mi spong snyam pa yul nges pa/ dus thung ngur spong la mi tshe gang bor mi spong snyam pa dus nges pa/ ga'an du spong la 'thab pa'i tshe sogs mi spong snyam pa gnas skabs nges pa/ yan la ga rags pa spong la phra ba rnam/sa mi spong snyam pa yan la ga nges pa'o/ /3tsho

re re'i mthar spong e nus snyam pa yang der 'gro ba 'dra bas dpyad/ de lta bu'i 'gal rkyen lnga gang rung dang ldan na sdom pa mi skye bas/ de dag kyang mkhan slob kyis tshig gsal bas ngo 'phrod dgos shing / ma/dor na dge bsnyen nas bzung ste bsnyen rdzogs kyi bar mgo myo/jug kun tu mkhan slob kyis kun slong dang cho ga'i don dang sdom pa skyes mtshams sogs brda sprod pa rnam pa kun tu gal che'o/ /de ltar cho ga rnam par dag pas bsnyen par rdzogs nas bsla ba bya mang po zhig yo da kyang rags bsdus ni/ ltung ba sde lngas ma gos par bya ba 'di yi na la / ltung ba sde lnga ni/ pham pa'i sde la pham pa bzhi/ de'i char gtogs kyi sbom/ po sbyor ltung nyes byas dang bcas pa dang / lhag ma'i sde la lhag ma bcu gsum sbyor sbom sbyor ltung nyes byas dang bcas pa dang / ltung byed kyi sde la spang ltung sum cu/ 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu/ de'i char gtogs kyi sbyor ltung nyes byas dang bcas/ pa dang / so ra bshags kyi sde la so ra bshaganu ba'i/ sbyo ra ci nga nyes byas dang bcas pa dang / nyes byas kyi nde la nyes byanu/ brgya dang bcu rte kā

gnyis sbyor ltung nyes byas dang bcas pa lnga'o/ /'di dag gi sdom tshig lung na/ bar sdom gyi tshul du yod pa/mi tshangs spyod dang dngos po rku/ /mi la bsad par mi bya ba/ /zhes sogs bkod nas bshad na'ang bde mod kyang /'dir nyams len gnad la 'beebs pa la mkhas pa'i dbang phyug khri gung thang pa'i tshe gcig gi nyams len chos spyod gsal ba'i sgron me las byung ba'i rtsa tshig 'di ni kha gsal zhing /'dzin chos su bde bas 'di la don 'grel gyi tshul du bshad par bya'o/ /rtsang ba pham pa'i sde/de la pham pa bzhi ni/mi tshangs spyod dang ga'an nor rku/ /mi'am mir chags gsod pa dang / /mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ste/ /pham pa bzhi ru rgyal bas gsu ngas/ /36

zhes gsungs la/ mi tshangs spyod kyi pham pa ni/ gong du dge tshul gyi skabs ltar yin la/ de las rgyas na mang 'gro bas 'dul ba'i gzhung las shes par bya/ ma byin len gyi pham pa'i rin thang gi tshad ni/ dngul zho gang gi tshad kyi rdzas/ ja ras gos gsum zangs lcags rin po che'i rigs rtswa shing snod cha yan chad kyi dngos po gang yin kyang gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba brkus pa 'phrog pa g.yo sgyus len pa dang / g.yar ba bskyis pa/gzhan la tshad de ster dgos pa so gas mi ster bar bdag gir byed na pham pa gnyis pa 'byung ba yin no/ / srog gcod kyi pham pa yang dge tshul gyi skabs ltar/ mi'am mir chags gang rung rang gis lag bdar ba dang / sman dang dug dang mthu dang ngan sngags dang bcol ba sogs kyis gsod pa dang / mdzod las/dmag la sogs pa don gcig phyir/ /thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge tshul slong dmag dang snying nad sogs la don gcig par song nas / ga'an gyis mi bas da pa la dga' ba bsgom pa la yang srog gcod dngos gzhi dang / pham 37

'dra dang pham pa gsum pa rnams dge bsnyen sogs la rim pa bzhin 'byung bar gsungs pas nyams 'jog dgos so/ /rdzun smra ba'i pham pa ni/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun yin zhing /mi'i chos ni gnyid la sogs pa/ thun mong la yod pa'i nyon mongs pa yin la/ de dang bral ba'i rtags mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs yod par smra ba dang / de'i rtags su lha 'dre gnod sbyin sogs mi ma yin dang / bar do ba sogs mthong bar ngag mtshan nyid lnga ldan gyis rdzun du smras pa la pham pa bzhi ba 'byung ba yin no/ /ngag mtshan nyid lnga ldan ni/ ngag yin pa/ rang gi yin pa/ bdag nyid dang 'brel ba/ ma nor ba/ gas la bar smras pa'o/ /dge tshul la 'di byung ba la pham 'dra'i nyes byas zer zhing / dge tshul slong la 'di bzhi 'chab bcas byung na sdom pa slar blangs kyang mi skye ba ni rje ngag dbang chos ldan gyi 'al nas/ shing ta la'i marga bo bcad na sngon por mi 'gyur 'phel zhing rgyas par mi 'gyur ba mi rung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / phyin chad mi skye ba dang mtshungs par 'dul ba lung la sa kyang gsungs so/ /38

pham lhag gnyis la char satogs sbom po yod pas/ mi tshangs spyod kyi ched du yul la nom nyug byas pa nas mthar thug ma rdzogs kyi bar thams cad mi tshangs spyod kyi spang bya'i sbom po dang / don de lus ngag tu thon pa nas nom nyug la thug gi bar sbyor ba'i sbyor ba'i nyes byas dang / yid la dran pa bsdam bya'i nyes byas yin no/ / mgo bcad pa'i kha lta bu lus stod smad gang yang med pa'i lam gsu/ma dang / lus la sogs pa'i bu ga bzhi gzhan la lam gsu ma/ gang rung du 'du shes pas spya da pa dang / ga'an la 'khrig pa bsten par bskos pa dang / bsten par rang gis khas blang ba sogs la mthar thug gi sbom po 'byung ba sogs/ tha na chags se myo/sa kyinu bud med la mig gis lta ba sogs la'ang nyes pa 'byung bar gsungs so / /'di'i bsla ba bya ni/ gnyid log pa'i tshe sgo gcod pa'am khrims grogs 'jog pa dang / bud med kyis glags lta ba'i gnas dang / smad 'tshong ma'i gnas su mi 'gro ba dang / chags sem sa med kyang bud med la mi reg pa mi lta ba bud med dang lhan cig khrims grogs med par mi 'dug mi 'gro ba sogs la slo ba dgos pa yin no/ /39

ma/ byin len la rku 'phrog sogs kyi ched du rdzas la nom nyug byas pa nas thob blo ma skyes pa'i bar thams cad sbyor sbom dang /thob blo skyes pa na mthar thug grub bo/ /de dag gi bya ba lus ngag citu thon nas nom nyug la thug gi bar thams cad sbyor ba'i nyes byas dang / yid la dran pa ni bsdam bya'i nyes byas so/ci /gzhan nor rgyu rdzas rin thang tshang ba brkus pa dang / 'du shes 'khrul te brkus pa dang / gzhan gyis rdzas tha na khab skud tsam zhig bdag gir byas pa la yang dngos gzhi'i sbom po 'byung bar gsu ngas stabs gzab dgos so/ /'di'i bslab bya ni/ gzhan gyi rdzas rnyed pa yu na ring mi 'jog pa dang / rdzas rnyed pa la bdag po yo da med rtsad gcod pa dang / ma shes pa'i tshe dge skul la ster ba dang / gzhan gyi rdzas la bag med du mi spyod pa sogs la bslab dgos so// srog gcod kyi sbyor sbom de/ dper na gsod byed kyi gri dang mdung sogs bsnun pa ma shi'i bar sbyor sbom dang / lus ngag tu thon pa nas sbyor ba de la thug gi bar sbyor ba'i sbyo ra ba'i ltung ba dang / yid la dran pa bsdam bya'i nyes byas so/ /'du shes 'khrul te mi dang mir chags gsod pa 0

dang / rang nyid gsod pa dang / gsod pa'i sbyor ba btang bas gsad bya shi ba dang / gsod sems med par mi'i rkang lag gcod pa dang / mi 'tshe bar btson du 'dzin pa dang /nad pa'i nad g.yog mi byed par shi ba sla'o zer ba sogs la sbom po'o/ /'di'i bslab bya ne/ sems can gang la yang khyod shi ba sla'o zhes pa'i gtam mi smra ba dang / nad g.yog mi mkhas pa mi 'jog pa dang / nad pa sogs la mtshon dang sman la sogs pa ma brtags par mi sbyin pa dang / nad pa sogs 'gro mi nus pa la lam du mi khrid pa dang / sa las so/gas kyi tshe dran shes bsten pa dang / srog chags la gnod pa yod med ma brtags par rdo dang shing sogs mi 'dril ba dang / dud 'gro sogs la khal mi theg pa mi 'gel ba dang / btsan thabs kyis mi 'ded pa dang /sems can ngal chad pa rnams ngal gso ru 'jug pa dang /gzhan nas 'ong ba ngal chad pa rnams zas skom gyis bsu ba dang /mtshon dang rdo la sogs pa la phongs zhes mi bsgo ba dang / ma brtags par gsad bya mi ston pa so gnu la slo ba dgos shing /yid nas kyang gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa la dam bca' rgyun 4/

du byed dgos par gsungs so/ /rdzun smra ba'i pham pa'i sbyor sbom ni/ ngag mtshan nyid lnga ldan gyi smra ba la zhugs nas pha rol porme don go ba lari thug gi bar dang / lus ngag tu thon nas sbyor ba la thug gi bar sbyor ba'i sbyor ba'i lhung ba dang / yid la dran pa bsdam bya'i nyes byas so/ /'di'i sbom po gzhan ni/ rdzun zur gtam ci rigs pas mi gsal bar smra ba dang / gzhan gyi smra ba dang du len pa dang / yi ger bris pa sogs dang / gzhan la smra ru bcug pa sogs la pha rol gyis don go ba dngos gzhi'i sbom po dang / don ma go na sbyor sbom yin rno/ /'di'i bslab bya ni/ mngon shes sogs yod kyang ma brtags par lung mi ston pa dang / mdor na dgos pa med na yo na tan gang yang sbed dgos shing / rdzun 'di dag gi kun slong skyes na yang 'gog dgos pa'o/ /lcang ba lhag ma'i sde/lhag ma'i sde tshan ni/ de nyid las/khu ba 'byin par byed pa dang / / — /

bud med rnams la reg pa dang / /yul der 'khrig tshig smra ba dang / /'khrig pa'i rnyed bkur bsngags pa dang / /pho mo gnyis sprad smyun byed dang / /ma gsol tshad 'das ma dag gzhir/ /khang ba rtsig par byed pa dang / /gnas der khang chen rtsig pa dang / /dge slo nga rnam par dag pa la / /pham pas skur ba 'debs pa dang / /de la bag tsam sku ra 'debs dang / /dge 'dun dbyen ni byed pa dang / /de 'dra'i rjes su phyogs pa dang / /bag med spyod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /khyim su/na 'byin par byed pa dang / /bka' blo mi bde'i lhag ma ste/ /lhag rnga/'i ltung ba bcu sa/su/ma mo/ /zhes gsu/ngas pa ltar/ dang po/ 'byin pa'i dge 'dun :3

lhag ma ni/ sems can gson por ma shi ba'i lus dngos sam dum bu sogs la bsten te rtsol ba'i sgo nas khams dkar po bsam bzhin du phyung ba'o/ /'di'i sbyor sbom ni/ khu ba 'byin pa'i phyir nom nyug byas pa nas dngos gzhi la thug gi bar yid la lus ngag tu thon nas nom nyug la thug gi bar sbyor ba'i sbyor ba'i ltung ba dang / yid la dran pa bsdam bya'i nyes byas yin pa sogs lhag ma bcu gsum po thams cad la rigs 'dra bas/rigs pas dpyad de shes par bya'o/ /de dag las gzhan pa'i thabs gang rung la brten nas khu ba phyung ba dang / rang la brten nas gzhan gyi khu ba phyung ba rnams ni dngos gzhi'i sbom po'o/ /chags sems kyis rang gi yan la ga gi rnam pa las rung du byas pa la lag pas reg pa bu ga 'tshir ba nyed pa sogs kun slong gi sbom po'o/ /'di'i bslab bya ni/ yul gang la'ang chags sems kyis mi blta ba dang / rang dang gzhan gyi khu ba 'byin 'dod pa sogs 'gog pa la rtag tu slo ba dgos par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa/ reg pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ chags sems kyis bud med kyi lus dngos sam/ skra dang bcas pa la reg 4

pa'o/ /'di'i sbyo ra ltung gi sbom po dang sbyor ba'i sbyor ba'i ltung ba rnams gong ltar shes par bya'o/ /'di'i char gtogs kyi sbom po ni/ lus bsten du mi rung ba'i bud med dang / bsten du rung ba'i bud med la reg pa dang / bsten du rung ba'i bud med la gos kyis bar chod par reg pa dang / ma ning sogs la reg pa la sbom po 'byung ngo/ /'di'i bslab bya ni/ skyes pa dang bud med gang gi yang / lus dang stan gos yan chad la chags sems kyis reg 'dod 'gog pa dang / chags sems med par gal te reg dgos byung na pha ma'i 'du shes bzhag ste res dargas par gsu ngas so /gsum pa/ 'khrig tshig smra ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ bud med tha snyad lnga ldan la 'khrig tshig smra ba dang / ga'an gyis smras pa dang du len pa'i ltung ba'o/ /tha snyad lnga ldan ni/ mi yin pa/smra shes pa/ don go ba/ shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ ma ning mtshan gnyis pa min pa'o/ /'di'i sbyo ra sbom sbyo ra ltung gnyis kyang sngar ltar ro/ /'di'i sbom po ga'an ni/ chaganu/ sems med kyang 'khrig tshig smra ba dang / chags pa'i gtam gang rsha

yin smras pa thams cad la 'byung ngo / /bslab bya ni/ yu'/ gang la'ang 'khrig tshig dang / chags pa'i gtam smra ba dang / rna bas nyan pa yan chad 'gog dgos pa'o/ /bzhi ba/ bsnyen bkur bsngags pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/yu pa bud med tha snyad lnga ldan la bdag la 'khrig pas bsnyen bkur byas na/ bsod nams thob bo bzang ngo zhes pa lta bu smras pa'i ltung ba'o/ /sbyor sbom sbyo ra ltu nga sngar bzhin yin la/ char gtogs sbom po ni/ bud med don ma go ba dang / ma ning sogs dang / skyes pa dang / ga'an don du smras pa sogs la 'byung ngo / /'di yan chad kyi lha ga myo/ bzhi dang / pham pa dang po lta bu ni/ gtso bor semanu can la chags pa'i dbang gis yin la/ de la mi sdug pa sgom pa gal che bas/ de'i bsgom tshul bsdus pa zhig 'og tu byang sems kyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur bas de 'dir blang bar bya'o/ /lnga ba/ smyan byed pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ skyes pa dang bud med mi tshangs spyod kyi don du mthun par byas pa ste/dper na rang gi nye du yin kyang rmya na gyi gtam smra ba dang / phan 6

tshun 'phrin bskyal ba dang / gzhan la bcol ba dang / skyes pa pho mo sngar mthun gyes pa mthun par byas pa la 'di 'byung ngo / /'di'i sbyor sbom sbyor ltung gnyis kyang sngar ltar ro/ /char gtogs sbom po gzhan ni/ don ga'an gyi ched du skyenu/ pa dang bud med bos pa 'phrad pa dang / phan tshun 'phrad pa'i don du ston pa dang / skyes pa la chung ma 'di nyos shig zer ba sogs la sbom po'o/ /drug pa/ khang ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/ ga'an la sa btsal ba'i gnas su srog chags la gnod pa yod pas gzhi mi rung ba dang / gzhan gyis rtsod pa'i nyen yod pa dang / 'jig rkyen yo da pas brtsam du mi rung ba ste gzhi ma dag pa gsu ma tshang ba'i gnas su/ nang gi srid du khru bco brgyad dang / zheng du khru phyed dang bcu gcig las lhag pa'i khang ba rang don du brtsigs na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor sbom sbyor ltung gnyis kyang sngar ltar ro/ /yan la ga gang rung ma tshang ba dang / steng ma g.yogs pa so gas la sbom po'o/ /bsla ba bya ni/ dge 'dun la gnang ba gsol ba dang /gzhi dag ma dag brtags pa sogs dgos so / /7

bdun pa/ khang chen gyi lhag ma ni/ gong du bshad pa'i gnas der dge 'dun la gnang bar ma gsol bar/ dge 'dun bzhi sde sogs dkon mchog gsum po gang rung gi don du khang ba brtsigs na'ang snang ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor sbom sogs sngar ltar ro/ /bslab bya ni/ gzhi brtags pa gnang ba gsol ba sogs sngar bzhin no/ /brgyad pa/ gzhi med skur 'debs kyi dge 'dun lhag ma ni/pham pa'i dag pa'i dge slo nga la/ bud med 'di dang mi tshangs pa spyod do/ /rdzas 'di brkus so/ /mi 'di bsad do/ /mi chos bla ma'i rdzun 'di smras so/ /zhes pa lta bus sku ra ba btab na lhung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor sbom so/gas sngar ltar ro/ /ngag mtshan nyid lnga ma tshang ba dang / nyams 'dun med par byung rgyal dang /khong khro dang / rgod bag dang / bzhad gad kyi ched du skur ba btab na sbom po'o/ /deng sang mtho dman kun la skur 'debs kyi lhag ma 'dis sbags 'dug pas kun gyis 'gyod sems chen pos bshags pa gyis shig / dgu ba/ bag tsam gyi lhag ma'i skur 'debs ni/ yu la de na8

la bya byed ma sbyar bar spyir pham pa bzhi bo gang rung gis skur ba btab na lhang ba 'dir 'gyur ro/ /sbyor sdom sogs sngar ltar ro/ /bcu ba/ dge 'dun dbyen gyi lhag ma ni/ dge 'dun phan tshun grangs brgyad tshang ba/ tha snyad gsum dang ldan pa/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam dag dang ldan pa/ lta ba mthun pa/ mtshan mthun pa ste chos drug ldan gyi bar du dbyen byas te/ phan tshun mi mthun par byas na ci nga ba 'di 'byung ngo / /tha snyad gsu ma ni/ smra shes pa/ don go ba/ shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa gsum mo/ /lta ba ma/thun pa ni bcas mchams la sa 'das ma 'das rnams mngon myo tho nges legs kyi bar chad du 'gyur mi 'gyur la bsam pa mthun pa'o/ /dge 'dun du ma 'o ngas par 'byed pa dang / gnas gcig tu tshogs pa'i dge 'dun dgos med du las la tshang bar mi bsdu ba sogs/ dang / sde sno da 'dzin pa gnas nas dbyung ba dang / ga'an gyis chad pas bcad pa'i slo ba ma rang gi slo ba myo/ra byed pa dang /dgos med du gcug tor dang thod dkris sogs 'dul ba dang 9

mi mthun pa'i gos 'chang ba dang / mi mthun pa'i bya spyod byed pa rnams la 'di'i char gtogs kyi sbom po 'byung zhing / sman gyi ched ma yin par mi sha dang / sha rlon za ba la kham re re la sbom po re 'byung bar gsu/ngas so/ /bcu gcig pa/ de rjes phyogs kyi dge 'dun lhag ma ni/gong ltar dbyen byed mkhan gyi grogs byas na ltung ba 'di 'byung zhing sbyor sbom sogs thams cad gong ltar ro/ /bcu gnyis pa/ khyim sun 'byin pa'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/glu len pa dang / gar byed pa dang / bro rdung ba dang / chang 'thung ba sogs kyis khyim pa mi dad par byas pa'i dge slong dge 'dun gyis gnanu nas phyung ba na rang skrod pa'i dge 'dun la 'dun pas 'gro/ zhe sdang gis 'gro/ gti mug gis 'gro/'jigs pas 'gro zhes pa sogs kyis sku ra ba 'debs pa mi gtong ba na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor sbom sogs sngar bzhin no/ /ba'ams bsgo sogs bzlog pa lnga re re'i mthar mi gtong ba la sbomyo/ po'o/ /bcu gsu/ma/ pa/ bka' blo mi bde ba'i dge 'dun lhag ma ni/50

dge 'dun dang dge slong gang rung gis ltung ba gleng ba 'gog cing gleng du mi 'jug par khyed cag dge yang rung sdig kyang rung bdag la ci yang ma smra zhig ces pa lta bu zer ba bzlog sgo lngas bzlog kyang mi gtong na lhung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor sbom sogs kyang sngar ltar ro/ /bzlog sgo lnga re re'i mthar mi gtong na sbom por 'byung ba'o/ /rang la dge slo nga gis ltung ba gang yin kyang gleng ba 'gog pa thams cad la nyes byas so/ /pham lhag gi ska bas 'dir sbyo ra sbom sogs ngo shes pa shin tu gal che ste/ pham/ pa'i char gtogs kyi sbom po/ lhag ma bcu gsum gyi lci/ lhag ma'i sbom po ltung byed kyi lci 'i na pas/ phyir bcos dang bshags bsdam gyi skabs su/ yid la dran sri gal che'o/ /rtsang byed kyi smre/skung byed la spang ltung dang 'ba' zhig pa gnyis las/ spa nga ltung sum cu'i bcu tshan dang po ni/ de nyid la sa/byin gyis ma brlabs chos gos soganu / /'ag bcu las 'das 'chang ba dang / /5

chos gos rnam gsum byin rlabs can/ /'ag tu 'bral bar byed pa dang / /kha skong re ba dang bcas pa'i/ /gos ni zla gcig 'jog pa dang / /tha snyad brgyad ldan dge slong mar/ /gos rnying 'khru ru 'jug pa dang / /gos kyis phongs pa ma yin par/ /dge slong ma las gos len dang / /phongs par min pa khyim pa las/ /gos ni slong bar byed pa dang / /chos gos med tshe slong rigs kyang / /stod g.yogs smad g.yogs zung las lhag/'dod pas slong bar byed pa dang / /khyim pas rang la bsngos pa'i gos/ /'bul/ long med par len pa dang / /sbyin bdag pho mo so so nas/ /rang la ster bar bsngos pa'i gos/ /52

'bul long med par len pa dang / /bskur ba yi ni spang ba dang / /zhes gsungs/ dang po/ gos zhag bcu 'chang spang ni/chos gos gsum po gang rung byin gyis ma brlabs pa sogs gos 'khor gsum khebs pa'i tshad du longs pa yan chad byin gyis ma brlabs par kha skong gi re ba dang bcas te zhag bcu gcig gi skya rengs shar ba na de la rang stobs dang / sngar rnyed kyi byin rlabs can dang / phyis rnyed la shan stobs kyis ltung ba 'byung ngo / /'di man chad la sbyor ba'i sbom po med la/ de yang 'chang 'bral 'jog gsum lhung bzed 'chang spang dgon pa ba'i 'bral spang ras chen dang dbyar rnyed bzhag 'phyis/ gsog 'jog pa'i spang ba ste/ brgyad po rnams gnang la tshad bzung yin pas/sbyor ltung med par gnam rtsed ldeng ma las gsungs so/ /rnga bal sogs rgyu mi rung ba dang khru gang gi tshad las chung ba'i gos zhag bcu las 'das par 'chang ba la nyes byas so / /gos ltung sman sasum la shan stobs kyis ltung ba 'byung tshul grangs mang zhing cung zad dka' bas 'dul ba'i gzhung chen mo dag las rsha3

shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ 'bral spang gi ltung ba ni/ snam sbyar bla gos mthang gos gsum ga gang rung tshad dang ldan pa byin rlabs can 'ag tu bral te phyi nyin gyi skya rengs dang po shar ma thag ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /chos gos tshad ldan min pa dang / rgyu'i byin rlabs can dang bral ba la nyes byas skyed par gsungs so/ /'di'i bsla ba bya ni/ spyir rgyun du dang khyad par ga'an du 'gro dus zhag tu 'dug pa'i tshe gding ba 'khyer dgos pa dang / ma khyer na phyi ra ldog dgos shing / gal te ldog ma thub na sading ba g.yar dgos pa dang / ma rnyed na bla gos 'ding dgos so / /'di lta ra chos rgas gsu/ma po gang rung dang 'ag gcig la'ang 'bral mi rung na/ snam sbyar dang mthang sham so gas gtan nas med pa'i dge slong rnams kyis lhung ba bshags tshul med pas ltung ba'i phung bo zhag grangs dang mnyam pa khur nas dmyal ba ngu 'bod du 'gro dargas par gsu/ngas pas/ des na bcun chas gyon pa sal che'o/ /gsum pa/ zla 'jog gi spang nyu nga ni/ chos gos gsu/ma po 5

gang rung gi rgyur bsngo sa te kha sko nga gi re ba dang bcas pa'i gos khru gang gi tshad du longs pa yan chad byin gyis ma brlabs par zhag sum cu 'das pa na/ rang stobs dang shan stobs kyis kyang lhung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /de ltar chos gos gsum po gang rung med pa'i dge slong gis chos gos gsum po gang rung gi rgyu'i don du 'khor gsum khebs pa'i gos 'ag dgu dang / khru gang gi gos zhag nyer dgu'i bar bzung chog pa dmigs bsal yin zhing / de phan chad du de dag kyang bzung mi chog na/ rgyu nom gyi ched du gos so gas 'ag tu 'chang mi chog pa de go bas// rang gi 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsu ma sogs la sa ga'an pa'i rgyu rdzas gar yod gang rnyed tham/sa cad de ma thag tu gzhan don dang chos phyogs su ma bsngos na 'ag re re'i kha nas ltung ba sna tshogs pa 'byung bas ltung ba'i phung bo khur te dmyal bar 'gro dgos na/rang gis rang la snying rje dgos pa'i bsam blo btang ste/ da nas tshe 'di la ma chagagu pa zhig byed ran no/ /'di'i bsla ba bya ni/ chos gos gsum dang gding ba so gas tshad ldan byed dgos par gsungs so/ /55

bzhi ba/ 'khrur 'jug gi spang ltung ni/ chos gos gsum dang gding ba gang rung dge slong ma chos brgyad ldan la 'khrud 'tshod 'phyag gsum gang rung byed du bcug na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /'dir dge slong ma med pas dge slo nga ma yan lag tu dgos pa'i ltung ba dngos gzhi mi 'byung yang / bud med nye du ma yin pa la gos bkru ba sogs kyi las bcol na nyes byas 'byung ngo / /'di'i bslab bya ni/ dge 'dun gyi nang khrims srung ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang 'gal ba'i khrims/ mi 'jog pa sogs so//lnga ba/ len pa'i spang lhung ni/ dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la sa gos blangs na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /rgas kyis ma phongs na bud med nye du ma yin pa las gos blangs na nyes byas 'byung bar mngon no/ /drug pa/ slong ba'i spang lhung ni/ gos kyis phongs pa ma yin par khyim pa chos drug ldan la gos bsla ngas rte thob na lhung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /chos drug ldan ni/ khyim pa mtshan nyid pa yin pa/ tha snyad lnga dang ldan pa/ 'u sa tha mal du gnas pa/56

ji dang nor tha dad pa/ nye du ma yin pa/ ma bslangs pa'i snga /ji satu ci bder stob pa min pa'o/ /ma thob kyang bslangs na bang skung ngo / / rsha— bdun pa/ slong rigs pa slong ba'i spang ltung ni/ chos gos gnyas yan chad med na slong rigs kyang / sbyin bdag chos drug ldan gcig la/ sbyor ba gcig gis chos gos gnyis kyi tshad las lhag pa bslangs nas thob na lhung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor ltung ni gong ltar ro/ /gos bslangs nas thob tshe chos gos gnyis kyi tshad las lhag pa'i cha phyir byin na ltung ba 'di mi 'byung ngo / /brgyad pa/ sbags pa slong ba'i spang ltung ni/ khyim pas rang la bsngos zin pa'i gos shes bzhin du ma phul gong du snga bar bslangs nas thob na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor ltung sngar ltar ro/ /dgu ba/ so so nas sbags pa slong ba'i spang ltung ni/ sbyin bdag so so nas rang la bsngos pa'i gos 'bul long med par snga bar blangs nas thob na nyu nga ba 'di 'byung ngo / /'di dag gi yan lag ma tshang na ltung ba na sma da pa 'byung ngo / /57

bcu ba/ bskur ba'i spang lhung ni/ sbyin bdag cig gis rang la gos rin gyi rin po che zhal ta ba la bskur ba na/ bskul ldan drug gi sgo nas zhal ta ba las gos sa ma rin po che blang ba na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /dge tshul slong rnacha/sa kyis rang la yod bzhin du yo byad gzhan la slong mi rung zhing / gzhan gyis 'bul bar gzas pa rnams kyang ma phul bar slong mi rung bar gsungs pa ni/ 'dod chung chog shes byed dgos pa'i don yin pas/ dge tshul slong gis rgyu nom gyi ched du 'bad 'bad dung dung mi byed pa gal che ste/ mdzod las/ chog mi shes pa dang /'dod chen can la ma yin no/ /zhes gsu ngas pa lta ra 'dod pa che ba dang / chog mi shes pa la yon tan gang yang mi skye bar gsungs so/ /bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ de nyid la sa/yul der dkon zhing rin che ba'i/ /srin bal las ni stan byed dang / /bal nag 'ba' zhig las byed dang / /de cha gnyis bsres sta na byed dang / /58

stan bshams spya da bzod yod bzhin du/ /lo drug nang du gnyis byed dang / /gding ba gsar ba byed pa'i tshe/ /gding ba rnying ba de nyid nas/ /bde gshegs mtho gang ma glan dang / /bal khur rgyang grags lhag khyer dang / /mtshan nyid brgyad ldan dge slo nga mar/ /bal rmi che/la du 'jug pa dang / /byin rlabanu myo/ byas rin po cher/ /reg ga'o/ reg tu 'jug pa dang / /skyed khe 'dod nas/ bun byed dang / /de 'dod nyo tshong byed pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bcu las/ dang po/ srin bal gyi spang skung ni yul der dkon zhing rin che ba'i srin bal gyis gdan byas na nyu nga ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyo ra ci nga sngar ltar ro/ /gnyis pa/ bal nag 'ba' zhig gi ltung ba ni/ bal nag 'ba' zhig las gdan byas na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyo ra 33

ltung gong ltar ro/ /gsum pa/ cha gnyis bsres pa'i spang ltung ni/ bal nag phyed mas lhag par bal dkar nag bsres pa'i gdan byas na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /ltung ba 'di gsum la'ang tshad dang mi ldan pa sogs yan lag ma tshang na nyes byas so/ /stan gyi tshad ni/che tshad srid du khru phyed dang lnga/ chung tshad khru phyed dang gsum mo//zheng ni gding ba dang mtshungs te/ khru do dang sor drug go /gding ba'i srid la khru gsum mo/ /'di dag kyang srin bal dang bal nag rin che ba'i dbang du btang ste/ 'dod pa che ba sogs 'gog pa'i don yin no/ /bzhi ba/ lo drug gi nang du gdan gnyis pa byed pa'i spang ltung ni/ gdan tshad ldan snga ma byas nas lo drug ma song bar gdan phyi ma byas na lhung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor ltung gong ltar dang yan lag ma tshang na nyes byas so/ /'di dag kyang 'dod chung chog shes kyi don no/ /lnga ba/ mtho gang gi spang ltung ni/ gding ba gsar ba byed pa'i tshe gding ba rnying ba nas bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang gi 60

tshad ma glan par longs spyad thengs re re la ltung ba re re 'byung ngo / /'di yang sbyin bdag gis phul ba'i rdzas chud zos la mi gtong ba dang / sbyin bdag gi tshogs rdzogs pa'i ched yin par gsungs pas/ dad pas phul ba'i rdzas chud zos la 'gro mi rung ba ni/ 'di sogs mdo bstan bcos mang po nas gsungs pas tshegs kyis thon dgos so/ /drug pa/ bal 'khur spang ltung ni/ bal 'khur tshad dang ldan pa khur nas rgyang grags gcig las lhag par song na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /rgyang grags phyed du khur ba la nyes byas re ste sbyor ltung ngo / /bdun pa/ bal rmel du 'jug pa'i spang ltung ni/ dge slong ma chos brgyad ldan la bal rmel ba/ 'khrud pa kha bsgyur ba sogs byed du bcug na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /bud med rnams la bal gyi las bcol na nyes byas so// /mdor na nye du ma yin pa'i bud med la/ gos 'khrud bal las rgas kyi bzo dang / zhing las sogs kyi las bcol na nyes byas 'byung bar gsungs so/ /6

brgyad pa/ gser dngul len pa'i spang ltung ni/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i rang gi yin pa'i rin po che dngos la rang don du reg gam reg tu bcug na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /rin po che chag gas sogs su song ste rin thang nyams pa dang /zangs ma sogs la reg na nyes byas so/ /chos gos sogs mthun rkyen gyis phongs na/ de dag gi rin tsam gyis rin po che la rung ba gsum chags kyi/ chos ldan gyi ched du mi dgos pa la mi chaganu so/ /gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che rang nor gyi 'du shes kyis 'chang mi rung ba ni/ dge tshul gyi ska bas nas kyang yi na te/ dge chul la rin po che la nor du bcang ba la ci nga ba bcu ba 'byung la / reg pa la ltung ba mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /rung ba gsum ni/ sbyin bdag bdag po nyid du rmas su gzhug pa'i rung ba/ khyim la zhal ta ba bdag po nyid du khas len du gzhug pa'i rung ba/ tshig brjod pa'i sgo nas rung ba'o/ /'di'i bsla ba bya ni/ rin po che la sa byas pa'i rngo byad mi 'chang ba'o/ /dgu ba/ mngon tshan can gyio spang ltung ni/ rang don du khe 6 2

spogs 'dod pas khyim/ pa chos lnga ldan la rin po che dang 'bru sogs gtad nas khe tshong byas pas/ skyed thob pa na ltang ba 'di 'byung ngo / /chos lnga ldan ni/ khyim pa yin pa/ tha snyad lnga dang ldan pa/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ nye du ma yin pa/ rang dang nor mi gcig pa'o/ /'di lnga dang gang rung mi ldan pa sogs la nyes byas so/ /bslab bya ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ched du skyed kyi rdzas sbyin bdag gis phul ba blangs chog par gsungs so/ /bcu ba/ nyo tshong byed pa'i spang ltung ni/khyim pa chos lnga ldan la rang don du khe sposas thob pa'i ched du mod pa'i tshe tshur nyo ba dang /dkon pa'i tshe phar btsongs pas khe spogs thob pa na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo //sbyor snyung sngar dang 'dra/ tshong 'di gnyis la khe spogs ma grub kyang char gtogs kyi ltung ba 'byung ngo / /'di'i bslab bya ni/ gzhan gyi nyo tshong la bar chad mi byed pa dang /rang gi chos gos sogs nyo ba'i tshe khyim pa yo nga na de la gtad dgos pa dang / gal te med na rang gi yu la dus dang bstun pa'i rin tshul dang mthun pa ster dgos pa dang / sha so gas 6 3

srog chags dang bcas pa'i rdzas mi 'tshong ba dang / dkon mchog gi ched du ma gtogs rang gar tshong mi byed pa sogs la slob dgos shing ma bslabs na nyes byas so/ /de ltar dge tshul slong gis mod nyo dkon 'tshong dang / khe bun sogs gtan nas mi rung bas/ ha cang ham pa che mi rung ngo / /bcu tshan gsum pa ni/ de nyid las/lhung bzed byin gyis ma brlabs par/ /zhag bcu las 'das 'chang ba dang / /lhung bzed spyad bzod yod bzhin du/ /lhung bzed gnyis pa btsal ba dang / /gla rngan mi ster 'thag 'jug dang / /'dod pas 'thag pa bskyed pa dang / /gos sogs byin pa 'phrog pa dang / /dgon pa 'jigs pa che ba'i sar/ /snam sbyar zhag drug 'bral gnang bar/ /snyad nas zhag bdun 'bral ba dang / /dbyar gyi char khebs ras chen ni/ /64

btsal sngas sbed pa 'phyis pa dang / /dbyar snyed bodag gir byed 'dod nas/ /bgod sngas 'jog pa'i 'phyis pa dang / /dge 'dun rnams la bsngos pa'i rdzas/ /gang zag bdag nyid la bsgyur dang / /sman bzhi byin len ma bshig par/ /thun mtshams las 'das gsog 'jog ste/ /spang ba'i ltung ba sum cu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po/ lhung bzed zhag bcur 'chang ba'i spang ltung ni/ lhung bzed tshad ldan byin gyis ma brlabs par zhag bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs dang po shar ba na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /sbyor ltung sngar ltar ro/ /'di la'ang shan stobs kyis ltung ba yod pas/ 'dul ba'i gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ lhung bzed 'tshol ba'i spang ltung ni/ lhung bzed byin brlabs 'chags pa yod bzhin du/ khyim pa chos drug ldan la lhung bzed bslangs nas thob pa na ltang ba 'di 63

'byung ngo / /sbyor ltung sngar ltar ro/ /lhung bzed yod bzhin du gnyis pa rin gyis nyo ba dang / lhung bzed med kyang rin yod bzhin du gzhan la slong ba dang / bzang ngan brje ba sogs la nyes byas so/ lhung bzed lhan pa lnga glan zin pa dang / glan dgos pa la byin rlabs mi 'chag go /'di'i bslab bya ni/ rang gi yo byad la ha cang zhen pa spang dgos pa dang / lhag par chags pa'i dngos po mi 'chang ba dang / rang la chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed sogs la rin yang 2da pa'i tshe gzhan la slo nga dgos pa dang / lhung bzed lhag pa yod na rab byung gzhan la ster dgos pa sogs la ma bslabs na'ang nyes byas so/ /gsum pa/ 'thag tu 'jug pa'i spang ltung ni/ khyim pa chos lnga ldan dang 'thag gla rang la mi 'bul bar thags pa la 'thag tu bcug pa'i gla rngan mi ster ba la ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo/ /ster dgos pa'i gla rngan gang yin kyang mi ster ba la nyes byas so/ /rku sems kyis mi ster ba la pham pa yang 'byung ngo / /bzhi ba/ 'thag pa bskyed pa'i spang ltung ni/ sbyin bdag gis phul ba'i dog pa'i tshad las lhag pa'i 'thag pa tha ga ba la 66

bskyed du bcug ste/ gos khru gang yan chad kyi rgyu'i dog pa zadade/ deri ched kyi gos rang gis thob pa na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo //rang la sbyin bdag gis bsngos pa las lhag pa'i rdzas gang yang len pa thams cad la nyes byas so/ /rku sems la pham pa'o/ /lnga ba/ byin 'phrog gi spang ltung ni/ dge slong chos brgyad ldan la/ gos dang lhung bzed dam yo byad sngar byin pa rku sems las ga'an pas slar 'phrog pa na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /chos brgyad ldan ni/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam dag dang ldan pa/lta ba mthun pa/ mtshan mthun pa/ tha snyad gsu/ma dang ldan pa/lus tha mal du gnas pa/ rang las rgyud tha dad pa'o/ /snga ra byin dang de nyid kyi rdzas phyin chad slar ster na'ang rgod bag sogs kyi bsam pas re zhig 'phrog pa dang / yul bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge tshul sogs la 'phrog pa la 'ang nyes byas 'byung bar gsungs so/ /rku sems yod na pham pa'o/ /pha rol po sdig snyung la 'jug pa dang / lus srog gi bar chad bsru nga ba'i ched yin na byin 'phrog la nyes pa med par gsu ngas so/ /drug pa/ brtad pa la sa byung ba'i spang ltung ni/ dbyar gyi 67

nang gi rnyed pa dgag dbye ma byas gong du bdag gir phyed bsngos pa dang / de'i gong du bgos pa bgod sngas pa dang / sra rkyang ma btang tshe dgag dbye'i phyi nyin ma bgos na bzhag 'phyi ba ste ltung ba 'di gsum 'byung ngo / /dbyar rnyed bzhag 'phyis kyi lhung ba 'di dad zas chud zos su/ 'gro ba la dogs pa yin par gsungs so/ /bdun pa/ dgon pa'i 'bral spang gi spang ltung ni/ dgon pa chom rkun dang chu sogs kyis 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i gnas su snam sbyar zhag drug pa'i skya rengs ma shar bar du 'bral bar gnang kyang zhag drug pa'i mtshan mo 'das kyi bar du bral na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /snam/ sbya ra dgag bya chung bas dgos dbang gis 'bral bar gnang ba/ bla gos dang mthang sham la ma gnang ba ni/ rab byung gi rtags nyams kyis dogs pa yin par gsungs pas/ deng sang 'gro 'dug cung zad tsam la'ang bla gos kyi byin rlabs dbyung ba 'di 'dul ba dang mi mthun zhing dgag bya che ste/ rab byung gi rtags mi 'chang ba ni bstan pa nub rkyen yin pa smos mi dgos so/ /68

brgyad pa/ ras chen gyi spang rtsang ni/ dbyar gyi gos ras chen rang la med pa'i tshe/ dbyar snga phyi'i khyad par gyis khas len pa'i dus kyi snga rol gyi zla ba gcig gi snga rol tu btsal ba ni btsal sngas dang / dbyar snga phyi'i khyad par gyis ston 'bring bo'i gnam stong gi mtshan mo dang / ston zla tha chung gi gnam stong gi mtshan mo 'das kyi bar du ras chen sbred pa la ma gtad na bzhag 'phyis te 3nga ba 'di gnyis 'byung ngo / /sbyor ltung sngar ltar ro/ /dgu ba/ bsngos bsgyur gyi spang lhung ni/ sbyin bdag gis dge 'dun nam dge slong gzhan la bsngos pa'i gos dang lhung bzed sogs bdag nyid la bsgyur te 'bul du bcug na ci nga ba 'di 'byung ngo / /dge 'dun gzhan la bsngos pa gzhan la bsgyur ba dang / shar phyogs pa la bsngos pa lho phyogs pa la bsgyur ba dang / mchod rten la bsngos pa sku gzugs la bsgyur ba sogs dang / bcu la bsngos pa nyi shu la bsgyur ba sogs thams cad la nyes byas 'byung bar gsungs so/ /'di la rku sems yod na pham pa'o/ /6ji)

bcu ba/ gsog 'jog gi spang ltung ni/ dus rung dang /thun tshod dang / zhag bdun pa dang / ji srid 'tsho bcang gi sman te/ sman bzhi gang rung tshad dang ldan pa byin len ma bshig par rang gi mthun mtshams las 'das pa na skung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /dus rung gi sman ni phye rtsam dang sha dang tshod ma sogs gong tshigs phan chad la za mi rung ba'i zas rnams yin te/ de dag gi byin len nyin gong ma 'das gong du bshig dgos/ thun tshod kyi sman ni/ ja sogs mtshan mo'i dmar thag tshun chad la 'thung chog pa'i btung ba rnam/nu yin la/ de'i byin len dmar thag de'i tshun chad du bshig dargas so/ /zhag bdun pa'i sman ni/ mar dang bu ram sogs dge slong rlung nad can la byin gyis brlabs te zhag bdun gyi bar du longs spyad chog pa de yin la/ de'i byin len zhag brgyad pa'i skya rengs tshun chad du bshig dgos so/ /ji srid 'tsho bcang gi sman ni/ nad ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar bcang ba'i a ru ra sogs sman rigs yin la/ de'i byin len nad sos pa'i mtshan mo ma 'das tshun chad du bshig dgos pas/ rang rang gi mtshams de 'das na gsog 'jog gi 70

ltung bar 'gyur la/ longs spyad pas yang ltung byed 'byung ngo //spang ltung sum cu bo 'di rnams bshags pa byed pa la/ gang la bsten nas spang ltung 'byung ba'i rdzas de gtan du spang ba dang /re zhig spang ba gang rung byed dgos la/ gtan du spang ba ni tshong gi spang ltung gnyis la skyed thon pa'i cha spang dgos pa dang skyed rtsa ba dang 'dres na thams cad spang dgos pa dang / lhung bzed 'tshol ba dang lhung bzed lhag pa 'chang ba spang dgos pa dang / 'thag skyed kyi lhag pa dang / sbyin 'phrog gi dngos po de nyid la sbyin dgos pa dang / bsngos bsgyur kyang gang la bsngos pa de la 'bul dgos shing / spang nyu nga byung ba'i rdzas de dag gis/ chos gos la lhan pa yan chad btab na chos gos thams cad spang dgos par gsungs so/ /re zhig spang ba ni/ dper na/ 'bral spang lta bu la/ chos gos gzhan yo da na gtan du spang ba mchog yin/ med kyang mi rnyed na rgyus shes pa'i dge slo nga zhig la re zhig spangs te/ bshags pa byas nas/ cung zad tsam gyis slar blus te byin rlabs byed dgos shing / de ba'in du gzhan rnams la rigs 'dra la / de'i phyir snga/nga ci nga zhes bya 7/

zhing chad las dang 'brel ba zhes kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i bcu tshan dang po ni/ de nyid las/rdzun gyi tshig ni smra ba dang / /dge slong gzhan la skyon brjod dang / /dbye phyir phra ma byed pa dang / /rtsod pa spong 'dod skyo sngogs dang / /nye du min pa'i bud med la/ /khrims grogs med par chos ston dang / /ma rdzogs lhan cig 'don pa dang / /gzhan gyi pham lhag gnas ngan len/ /ma rdzogs pa la brjod pa dang / /mi chos bla ma dgos med du/ /ma rdzogs 'phags min smra ba dang / /zhal ta ba la dge 'dun gyis/ /rnyed par rigs par bsngos pa la/ /bshes ngor byas zhes skur 'debs dang / /72

so so thar ba'i bcas mtshams la /brnyas thabs kyis ni khyad gsod dang / /zhes gsungs/ dang po/ rdzun smra ba'i ltung byed ni/ rdzun la pham lhag sbom po/ nyes byas skur 'debs kyi skung byed sogs yod pas/ de gang yang ma yin pa'i rdzun smras na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /yul ni rdzun smra ba'i pham pa dang mtshungs so/ /ngag tu thon nas don ma go ba'i bar sbyor ltung ngo / /mna' 'dor ba thams cad la char gtogs kyi nyes byas so/ /gnyis pa/ skyon smra ba'i skung byed ni/ yul dge slong chos brgyad ldan gyi skyon brjod pa'o/ /chos brgyad ldan las gzhan pa'i dge slong dang / dge tshul man chad mi dang mi ma yin su la skyon brjod na'ang char gtogs kyi nyes byas dang / dud 'gro la skyon brjod na'ang nyes byas so/ /gsum pa/ phra ma byed pa'i ltung byed ni/ dge slong chos dgu dang ldan pa mthun pa'i bar du phra ma byed pa'o/ /su gang gi bar du phra cim gang byas pa la rdzun smra'am phra ma'i nyes pa skyed do/ /bzhi ba/ skyo sngogs byed pa'i skung byed ni/ dge slong chos 73

brgyad ldan gnyis yan chad kyi rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi bar byas pa de rang zhi byed lagatogs pas rtsod pa de slong ba'i tshig smras pa pha rol ba'i don go ba'o/ /rtsod pa gang yin kyang slong ba la nyes byas so/ /lnga ba/ khyim pa mo la chos ston pa'i ltung byed ni/ bud med khyim pa mo tha snyad lnga ldan sogs la khrims grogs kyi rigs skyes pa med par chos ston pa'o/ /khrims grogs tshad ldan yod kyang bud med g.yem zhing mi dad pa sogs la chos ston pa dang / de dang lhan cig 'dug 'gro sogs la nyes byas so/ /drug pa/ 'don pa'i ltung byed ni/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dge tshul man chad dang / bsnyen par rdzogs kyang khrims 'chal dang bslab byin dge slong sogs dang lhan cig sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'don pa'o/ /bka' min pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshig 'don pa la nyes byas so/ /bdun pa/ gnas ngan len brjod pa'i ltung byed ni/ dge slong gzhan gyi pham lhag gang rung gi ltung ba bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang / 'phags pa min pa la brjod pa'o/ /pham lhag las 74

ga'an pa'i nyu nga ba dang rang gi ltung ba de das la brjod pa nyes byas so/ /brgyad pa/ mi chos bden smra'i ci nga byed ni/ rang gi thob pa'i yon tan bsam gtan dang po dang / mngon shes sogs mi chos bla ddha/ 'phags pa min pa'i bsnyen pa ra ma rdzosas pa lnga dgos med du smras pa'o/ /dgos pa chen po med na rang gi yon tan gang yod gsang dgos so/ /dgu ba/ skur ba 'debs pa'i ltung byed ni/ dge slo nga rngoos brgyad ldan gyi zhal ta ba la 'dis dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa bshes ngor byas ce mi dgos par bsngos so zhes sku ra ba 'debs pa'o/ /yan la gam tshang ba'i skur 'debs la nyes byas so/ /bcu ba/ khyad du gsod pa'i lhung byed ni/ bslab gzhi ston pa'i 'dul ba'i tshig mang nyung gang yin kyang khyad du gsad pa'o//khyad du gsod lugs mang yang 'di ni bslab gzhi phran tshegs 'di lta bu zla ba phyed phyed 'don ci dgos zhes 'don rin med pa'i rnamyo/ pas/ yin zhing / gsung rab kyi tshig gang yin kyang khyad du gsod na nyes byas so/ /tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ston 7nya

pa'i tshig ni phan bde'i gzhi yin pas khyad du gsod pa ltung ba shin tu lci bar gsungs pas thugs chud 'dzin dgos so/ /bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ de nyid las/sa bon skye ba 'joms pa dang / /drang bo'i dge 'dun zhal ta bas/ /nye ring byas zhes 'phya ba dang / /bsgo ba rna la gzon pa dang / /chud 'dza'i gnas su mal bshams dang / /rtswa dang lo ma'i gdan bting ba/ /ma bsdus ma bcol 'gro ba dang / /sngar gnas dge slo nga skrod pa dang / /de la phyis gnod byed pa dang / /rtsa ba 'byung la 'dug pa dang / /srog chags dang bcas chur spyod dang / /rim gsu/ma las lhag khang byed dang / /zhes gsu/ngas la/ dang po/ sa bon skye ba bcom pa'i ci nga byed ni/ nas la sogs pa'i myu gu skye rung gi sa bon dang ljon 76

shing sogs nyams par byas sam byed du bcug pa la/ sa bon grangs de snyed kyi skung ba re re 'byung ngo / /sta re sogs kyis shing rtsa ba nas gcod pa la yang snun thebs re la nyes byas re dang / bcad pa la lhung ba dngos gzhi'o/ /shing la sogs pa'i zun pa bshus pa dang / shing dang rtswa dang / lo tog la sogs pa 'di bcad na zer ba rnams la nyes byas so/ / bslab bya ni/zi'ishing me tog nags tshal sogs rang byung khams kyi mdzes sngongs la gtor brlag mi gtong ba dang rang gnas yul khams mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i dag zhing du bsgyur ba la goms par bya'o/ /skye ba dang sa bon dang la phug dang rtsi tog sogs rung ba byed tshul kyang shes par bya'o/ /rung chu 'debs pa so gas rung btsāms cad bsnyen par ma rdzogs pas byed dgos so/ /gnyis pa/ 'phya ba'i ltung byed ni/ dge slong chos brgyad 35da gzhan nam zhal ta ba sogs kyis rang la zas gos dman pa ster ba sogs nye ring ma byas bzhin du byas so zhes sku ra ba 'debs pa'o// ga'an rdan du 'phya ba so gas la nyes byas so// /gsum pa/ bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i ltung byed ni/ dge 77

slong chos brgyad ldan gyis/ rang 'a tshul khrims kyi bslab pa sogs brjod pa'am/ chos ldan gyi dri ba sogs la lan drang bor mi 'debs par tshig 'khyog po'am/ cang mi smra bas rna la gzon pa'o/ /bslab bya ni/ 'thab mo'i nang du mi gnas pa la slob pa dang / bsgo ba rna la gzon pa ngan pa'i grangs su gzhug dgos so/ /bzhi ba/ gnas mal gyi ltung byed ni/ dge 'dun gyi gnas mal stan sogs srin bu dang rlung dang char sogs kyis chud za ba'i gnas nas sprugs pa dang bsdu ba sogs do dam ma byas pa'am/ tshul mthun la ma gtad par 'gro ba na ltung ba 'di 'byung ngo / /bslab bya ni/ rang gi mkhan po dang / slob dpon sogs dang lhan cig la ma du 'gro ba'i tshe de dag gi stan sogs tshul bzhin du 'khur dgos pa sogs so/ /lnga ba/ gding ba'i lhung byed ni/ dge 'dun gyi gnas khang du rang gis rtswa dang lo ma'i gdan bting ba ma bsdus ma bcol bar 'gro ba'o/ /rtswa dang 'o ma sogs khyim pa'i gnas sogs dang / 'chag sar bting ba dang / gos skam pa'i phyir bting rka8

ba masbyi bsdu sa pa dang / lci ba dang shing sogs sro sa chags skye ba'i sa gzhir bzhag pa sogs la nyes byas so/ /drug pa/ skṛd pa'i ltung byed ni/ dge slo nga chos brgyad ldan 'di phyir phan pa'i rkyen dang mi ldan par dge 'dun gyi gnas nas skrod pa'o/ /bzhad gad tsam gyi ched dang / bsla ba byin dge slong dang dge tshul sogs skyod pa la nyes byas so/ /bdun pa/ phyis gnod kyi ltung byed ni/ phan pa'i rkyen dang mi ldan par dge slong chos brgyad dang ldan pa gnod pa gang yang rung bas zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /dge slong la tho 'tsham gyi bya ba byas tshad ltung ba 'dir 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi rnam pas byed kyang 'dra'o/ /dge tshul sogs la de ltar byas pa la nyes byas so//brgyad pa/ rtsa ba 'byung la 'dug pa'i ltung byed ni/ thog khang rdol ba'i nyen can gyi steng du khri'am khri'u sogs kyi rtsa ba phur bu lta bu'i steng du nyal ba'o/ /dgu ba/ 'debs pa'i ltung byed ni/ srog chags phra mo mig la ma du snang ba dang bcas pa'i chu la bathol ba dang 'obs kha bsgyur ba dang sa rdo 'debs pa sogs de la spyad nas srog chags 79

ji snyed shi ba de snyed kyi ltung ba re 'byung ngo / /bslab bya sogs 'og tu bshad do/ /bcu ba/ rim gsum las lhag pa'i ltung byed ni gtsug lag khang sogs jig pa'i 'jig nyen dang bcas par rim pa gsum las lhag pa jig pa'o/ /bcu tshan gsum pa ni/ de nyid las/nye du min pa'i dge slong mar/ /ma bskos dam chos ston pa dang / /bskos kyang nub par ston pa dang / /dam chos tshul bzhin ston pa la/ /zas phyir ston ces smra ba dang / /dge slong ma yi gos bzo dang / /de la chos gos ster ba dang / /dge slong ma dang lhan cig tu/ /grogs med rgyang grags 'gro ba dang / /dge slong ma dang lhan cig tu/ /grur zhugs rgyang grags 'da' ba dang / /80
